none: PAS LIN-4D3E76: Roman copper alloy TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper-alloy TOT ring dating to the second or third centuries. The ring is of Henig type XI, and has a broad oval bezel and tapering shoulders. The perimeter of the shoulders and bezel is set back from the main body.
